title: Reduce the declared finite-bath photopump stationary problem without choosing independent ion setpoints
statement: With ATPase off and no active K/Cl work in the declared positive passive network, stationarity forces Vm=EK=ECl and JKCl=0. r=exp(-FVm/RT) gives nKi=Ktot*r*w/(r*w+u), nCli=Cltot*w/(w+r*u), and nNai=Ai-nKi+nCli+C*Vm/F. Osmotic balance reduces composition to one scalar volume root for each Vm.

requires: The declared finite-bath model, positive passive K/Cl network and no independent K/Cl active work, shared water/inventory/charge and stationary gates.
Current labels150/100/350pA are Imax parameters of the added law, not measured or constant actual photocurrents.
provides: With ATPase off and no active K/Cl work in the declared positive passive network, stationarity forces Vm=EK=ECl and JKCl=0. r=exp(-FVm/RT) gives nKi=Ktot*r*w/(r*w+u), nCli=Cltot*w/(w+r*u), and nNai=Ai-nKi+nCli+C*Vm/F. Osmotic balance reduces composition to one scalar volume root for each Vm.
assumptions: No tissue recovery, independent ion setpoints, static-fold-to-basin inference or acquired pump waveform. Source rest and washed-out/closed preparations are distinct.
costs: The Na pump supplies actual work; gross productive photons, ATPase handoff and physical delivery/expression/control are separately charged.
contract.units: r dimensionless, w,u volumes in consistent units, n ion amounts, C*Vm/F charge-equivalent amount with the source pF/mV/fmol conversion.
contract.obstruction: A voltage or sodium threshold alone cannot replace the complete shared-inventory stationary problem.

body: The passive K and Cl channel/cotransport dissipations are nonnegative; stationary inventories and zero combined passive charge current make their sum zero. Their positive conductances force equal electrochemical potentials, not freely selected K/Cl concentrations. Apply the shared finite mass/water and capacitor-charge identities, then osmotic balance. The required added pump current balances the actual stationary sodium leakage. This analytic reduction does not decide stability, basin membership, waveform optimality or a calibrated biological current.

evidence.range_scope: Actual passive K/Cl stationary reduction and distinction between static folds and dynamic basin proof.
